notes.title: Race Mode, Collision, New Physics, Map Improvements [v0.3.0]
notes.content:
[h1]Race Mode[/h1]

In this new game mode, your golfing skills are judged by speed. However, you can still stroke out and get a max time penalty. This mode doubles as a built-in speed run.

[h1]Collision[/h1]

You can now collide with other players! Use this strategically to take out your enemies...

[h1]New Physics[/h1]

The ball physics are totally reworked, with smoother motion and less overall power.

[h1]Map Improvements[/h1]

Many holes have been reworked, especially on Valley and Haven. In some cases there are totally new holes (Valley 17, Haven 2, 11, 15). Castle lighting has been reworked.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

There are many other small changes, such as to the UI. With so many changes, there may be issues so I appreciate any reports on Steam or Discord.

Discord: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/ZgWra97]https://discordapp.com/invite/ZgWra97[/url]
Steam Forum: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/868080/discussions/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/868080/discussions/[/url]

Map 4 is on the way...

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33070641/0e8c1344001339e4a5e24070e42ee381d0486061.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33070641/02c2d53e4276d9cfbaf5afbb0ab072f0783ddd15.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: FAQ [Update Coming Soon]
notes.content:
[b]Q: Is this game abandoned?[/b]

A: No. It's being actively developed with a major update coming soon, likely this month.

[b]Q: When will we get new maps, game modes etc.?[/b]

A: Hopefully soon, I have been working on the fourth map since this summer, plus a new game mode. A level editor is an eventual goal.

[b]Q: I have low FPS, what should I do?[/b]

A: Try setting your resolution lower in addition to dropping your quality setting. I am working on optimizing the game.

[b]Q: How often do I get an item?[/b]

A: About every 30 minutes, upon completing a game. There is also a special, rare item.

[b]Q: Where do I get in touch?[/b]

A: Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/ZgWra97

Steam Forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/868080/discussions/



Thank you for playing, and I am trying to solve any issues the players might have.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33070641/02c2d53e4276d9cfbaf5afbb0ab072f0783ddd15.png[/img]

notes.title: Hats and Freecam (Update 0.1.2)
notes.content:
[h1] Hats [/h1]

Unlock 14 sweet hats at random by playing! Hats are tradable and marketable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33070641/806ad5708d73f4a0178317098f5601e2583ade6b.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33070641/0e8c1344001339e4a5e24070e42ee381d0486061.png[/img]

[h1] Free Camera [/h1]

You can now press "C" to open the free camera and zoom around the map!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33070641/f6eb440c914860484177ee7f1a869e8df9b69da4.png[/img]

[h1] Other [/h1]

-UI improvements
-Adjusted mouse sensitivity
-Fixed chat selection issue
-Reduced scoreboard lag issue

[h1] In Closing [/h1]

Thank you for trying out Golf Galore, and we are open to your feedback here or on Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/ZgWra97 . The game is still in an early stage but we intend to keep it updated very frequently!

notes.title: Trails & Achievements (Update 0.1.1)
notes.content:
[h1] Trails [/h1]

Trails are the first part of the new item system! Unlock 15 colorful trails at random by playing! Trails are tradable and marketable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33070641/206166369be09c8826e6f76b2d6cb5c099d830a5.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33070641/85a6c20f102bbd5f5acb227ede16660cdef3cd8d.png[/img]

[h1] Achievements [/h1]

There are 3 new achievements. Also, the par achievements have had their difficulty adjusted to be more manageable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33070641/d38e0c4322d2a6b3109750b72adda380b256a2dc.png[/img]

[h1] Other [/h1]

Mostly by request, these things have been changed:
-Lower possible mouse sensitivity
-New time options up to 5 minutes (unlimited time has potential abuse)
-Various visual improvements

[h1] In Closing [/h1]

Thank you for trying out Golf Galore, and we are open to your feedback here or on Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/ZgWra97 . The game is still in an early stage but we intend to keep it updated very frequently!

[h1] Edit: [/h1]

-Added video options, including uncapped FPS and view distance
